title: Ngondi language
text: Ngondi, also known as Ngundi or Ingundi, is a Bantu language spoken primarily in the Republic of the Congo. It belongs to the Northwest Bantu branch of the Niger-Congo language family, classified under Zone C, group C.10 in the updated Guthrie list of Bantu languages.
